description: This Lua script initializes a graphical window, defines a Logo class with movement and collision behaviors, creates multiple Logo instances with random positions and velocities, loads an image, and animates the logos within the window.

classes.name: Logo
classes.description: Represents a moving logo object with position, velocity, size, and methods for collision detection, movement, and rendering.

methods.name: Logo:init
methods.description: Constructor method to initialize a Logo object with position, velocity, and size.

methods.name: Logo:collision
methods.description: Checks and responds to collisions with window boundaries for the Logo.

methods.name: Logo:move
methods.description: Updates the Logo's position based on velocity and performs collision detection.

methods.name: Logo:draw
methods.description: Renders the Logo image at its current position.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the graphical window, creates Logo instances, loads image, and sets frame rate.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Clears the background and draws/moves all Logo instances each frame.
